source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1955, p. 8 ("Fermanagh's public boards personnel - two contests")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the nomination list names one candidate only

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Derrylea; the other divisions were uncontested and are recorded from the Fermanagh Herald's full nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8). Dresternan is not in the Herald's printed list and is not yet found (7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1955, p. 8 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Colebrooke—Alfred Hurst' as printed (previously Hart); Alfred Hurst held Colebrooke in 1939 and 1949.
